author: KEXP
description: Bay Area underground luminary Hannah Lew offers a sparkling set of synth-pop on her self-titled debut. In-studio with host DJ Cheryl Waters, she shares a magnetic live performance of "Sunday" and more from the record.
title: Hannah Lew performs "Sunday" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Hannah Lew performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded June 26, 2026.

Sunday 00:32
Another Twilight 04:33
Move In Silence 08:00
Siloed 12:48

Hannah Lew - Bass, synth, vocals
Nick Clark - Drums, sample pad
Peter Woods - Guitar

Host: Cheryl Waters
Audio Engineer: Kevin Suggs & Jon Roberts
